core_goal: A block copolymer combining rigid poly(L-lactide) segments for high Tg with tough poly(ε-caprolactone) segments to preserve elasticity and fracture resistance.
mechanism_one_liner: The crystalline poly(L-lactide) blocks elevate the overall Tg through chain rigidity while poly(ε-caprolactone) segments absorb mechanical energy via chain mobility, preserving toughness
risk_one_liner: Potential phase separation issues leading to inconsistent mechanical properties
pros_short: ['Well-established chemistry (PLLA/PCL) with predictable synthesis and degradation.', 'Clear structure-property relationship; block lengths easily tune Tg, toughness, and degradation rate.']
cons_short: ['Phase separation can lead to inconsistent mechanical properties if not well-controlled.', "Degradation rate may be too slow for some applications due to PCL's hydrophobicity."]

core_goal: Alternating copolymer of rigid terephthalate units and flexible aliphatic diols, balancing stiffness with chain mobility.
mechanism_one_liner: Aromatic rings restrict chain rotation to increase Tg while aliphatic spacers allow plastic deformation for toughness
risk_one_liner: Crystallinity reduction from irregular sequences impairing mechanical properties
pros_short: ['Classic copolyester design with well-understood synthesis and structure-property relationships.', 'Aromatic units effectively increase Tg; aliphatic spacers provide toughness.']
cons_short: ['Acidic degradation products (terephthalic acid) may cause inflammation.', 'Achieving the ideal alternating sequence for homogeneous properties can be synthetically challenging.']

core_goal: Diels-Alder crosslinked network using furan/maleimide chemistry for reversible bonds that enhance Tg while allowing self-healing.
mechanism_one_liner: Rigid bismaleimide crosslinks elevate Tg through restricted mobility, while reversible Diels-Alder bonds dissociate under stress to dissipate energy and preserve toughness
risk_one_liner: Retro-Diels-Alder reactions occurring at body temperature altering properties
pros_short: ['Dynamic bonds offer self-healing and excellent energy dissipation for toughness.', 'Rigid crosslinks can significantly elevate Tg.']
cons_short: ['Reversible Diels-Alder reaction equilibrium at body temperature could destabilize the network.', 'Synthesis of furan-functionalized PCL and control of crosslink density is complex.']
